MNQ — October 9, 2026 · Unsupported EM-Top Rally: Put-Ladder Reversion, Cluster Low at the 10:00 SKEW Turn, False Ready Print, Grind Back to the ZG

MNQ · Micro NASDAQ-100 Unsupported Rally +179 Into the 31,242 Lid Balanced × No Put Premium Call Share Collapse 79% → 48% Puts Only Below the Real Price Pivot 31,142 Break — High 31,181 9:34 ✅ SKEW Turn 10:00 — Low 30,984 in the Cluster ✅ False Ready 11:00 — No SKEW Zone Drop ✅ Ready 12:15 — No Price Trigger Grind Back to the ZG VXN +2.5–3SD = Low ✅

1 — Market Context

NQ rallied ≈ 179 points overnight from the 31,023 close after Thursday's −1.25% Nasdaq drop; crude eased (Brent ≈ $102.8) and the 10-year yield rose to 5.25%. The overnight range was 30,952–31,266: the low sat on the 30,942–30,972 floor and the high was rejected at the 31,242 lid after about four hours of tests (≈ 03:00–08:00). At 10:00 the University of Michigan preliminary October sentiment printed 46.3 vs 47.8 expected (1-year inflation expectations 4.7%, 5-year 3.5%). Friday was the weekly 0DTE expiry. The first DEX(BOTH) print arrived late, at 9:45.

🟨 Open → 10:11 — Down the put ladder to the cluster

The pre-market print gave the reason for the drop. At 8:00 the 0DTE DEX(OI) showed no call DEX at or above the real price (largest +19M) after the OI refresh cut the call share from 79% to 48% — the overnight rally at the EM top had nothing holding it. SKEW 0.003 confirmed it: the puts below were held but priced flat, and there was no call premium — no one was paying to break the 31,242 lid. Price at the top of the expected move, with only a put ladder beneath, pointed to reversion down the ladder.

With no print until 9:45, this pre-market read carried the open. Price broke the 31,142 pivot within minutes of the 9:34 high and stepped down the ladder. At 9:45 SKEW jumped to 0.154 while σ fell — the cheap puts were repriced as protection. At 10:00 SKEW slowed to 0.123 with σ still falling: the protection buying stopped. The 10:00 data added only wicks and a one-tick VXN spike; price held, and the low printed at 10:11 at 30,984.

The low came inside the 30,972–30,992 cluster, not at the largest put (30,942). Stacked medium strikes absorb a move step by step before the big wall is reached, so the take-profit zone was the cluster edge facing price (30,992).

🟨 11:00 / 11:15 — False ready print

DEX flipped to +2.81B and the 31,142 put turned into a +655M call, but SKEW stayed in the 0.1xx zone (0.120) and price never closed above 31,142. At 11:15 the calls halved (31,142 → +210M) and a −308M put appeared at 31,042. Without the SKEW zone drop the flip did not hold.

🟨 12:15 → close — Ready print, no price trigger, slow grind

SKEW dropped below 0.10 (0.074), DEX reached +6.61B, the 31,042 put unwound and the 31,092 call grew to +1.2B under price; 12:30 confirmed on DEX. The trigger — a 1-minute close above 31,142 — never came. The prints alternated between call decay and regrowth, and price stair-stepped up through 31,012 → 31,082 → 31,092 → 31,117 to close at 31,123, just under the ZG.

Why a grind, not a squeeze: - Balanced book. Oct 7 and Oct 8 had call-heavy books (80 / 20, 68 / 32) that squeezed after the ready print; Oct 9 (48 / 52) had little call fuel above. - Friday expiry and the weekend. Overnight longs took profit at the lid and opening shorts at the cluster; no one carried a long from the low to the top. As the 0DTE put book decayed, dealer hedges were bought back and price drifted up. - CVD (reference only) made its net selling in the first 15 minutes, then stayed in a box — buying waves were absorbed every time.

Live DEX(BOTH) strikes: 31,082 / 31,092 / 31,117 were small or absent on the pre-market OI and GEX charts. They were built by the day's 0DTE volume where price traded, and price respected them like walls. The pre-market walls set the range (31,042–31,142); the live strikes set the pins inside it.

Live DEX(BOTH) strikes (white): 31,012 · 31,082 · 31,092 · 31,117. Afternoon stair-step through each level to the close under the 31,132–31,142 ZG / Total Flip.

No 1-minute close through the trigger = no trade 31,142 never closed above
